# Fixture provenance

These are compact, pinned slices shaped like SEC Company Facts responses. The annual values are transcribed from the following filed 10-Ks and are used only for deterministic extraction tests:

- [Walmart FY2026 Form 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/104169/000010416926000055/wmt-20260131.htm)
- [Target FY2025 Form 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/27419/000002741926000016/tgt-20260131.htm)
- [Costco FY2026 Form 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/909832/000090983226000093/cost-20260830.htm)

The tests construct small synthetic cumulative-period examples inline for Q2 and Q4 arithmetic. Synthetic values are not presented as financial evidence or loaded into the production dataset.
